The scheme field: OIML certificates of conformity are issued under either Scheme A or Scheme B of the OIML-CS. For R51 (automatic catchweighing instruments), typically Scheme A. Hmm, the document doesn't explicitly state scheme. The number format "R51/2006-DE1-13.01" is the traditional format. I might omit scheme or infer "A".
